one_liner: Mermaid CLI (mmdc) is a local open-source renderer with no hosted API or credentials. Mermaid.ai's separate hosted REST API (free-account API key, credit-metered) and its MCP server could back a toolkit instead.
auth_notes: The CLI itself needs no credentials; the pages fetched do not describe its auth directly. The hosted Mermaid.ai API uses a Bearer API key. The MCP server supports OAuth 2.1 or a manually pasted token, but the REST API documents only Bearer keys.
access_notes: The hosted API works with any Mermaid account including a free one (Basic plan: 500 personal API credits per month). Calls are credit-metered and the API is in open beta.
blocker_notes: Mermaid CLI is a local tool, not a hosted API. A toolkit must target the separate Mermaid.ai hosted API (credit-metered, beta, no uptime guarantee) or run the CLI itself in a sandbox. Whether the hosted API counts as this app is a judgment call.

evidence.quote: Mermaid API is a hosted service that runs Mermaid for you: your program sends diagram code over HTTP and gets back a validation result, an image, or new diagram code.
Any Mermaid account works, including a free one, and every account gets a monthly allowance of API credits. Paid plans include a bigger allowance.
Authentication is free — you can sign up for a free Mermaid account (the Basic tier) to get started.
